mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_image_history ( prompt, provider_name, model_name, image_size, file_name, file_path, mime_type, file_size, created_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{prompt}, #{providerName}, #{modelName}, #{imageSize}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{createdBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_image_history WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
